caption: The drawing features four distinct objects arranged with ample space between them, all centered on a plain, light beige or off-white background. At the top center is a horizontal bar consisting of five round, golden-yellow elements, likely gemstones, set in close succession. Below this, in the middle, is a golden ring with a series of raised, rounded segments along the upper edge, creating a scalloped pattern. To the left of the ring is a vertical, intricately detailed piece resembling a decorative pin or brooch, primarily golden in color with dark accents, and featuring symmetrical ornamental designs. To the lower right of the ring, there is a narrow, horizontal rectangular label in yellow with capitalized text written on it, containing numbers and a year: "G.98. v. Serial. 52. 1857." In the bottom left corner of the page, "JOHN. H. TERCUZZI." is written in small, neat letters. The objects are rendered with delicate shading to suggest three-dimensional form, and the overall composition is sparse, focusing attention on the individual items.
title: Topaz Ring
